subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

IDEOLOGY : YGILIYDC :: HARDWARE : YRUWDRUH :: ISOLATED : ?
solution: Here, we use the table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad95915734dcda89bd14d99c5e11bca270277f56f26dacf15662286599f41d2.png] **Given:** IDEOLOGY : YGILIYDC :: HARDWARE : YRUWDRUH :: ISOLATED : ? **Logic: **(6) is subtracted from the position value of the Vowels, with no changes in consonant position value and written diagonally. IDEOLOGY : YGILIYDC →
